tasks.gr12-finance-interest-banking-inflation-: Grade 12 Mathematical Literacy Term 2 — Finance: Interest, Banking and Inflation. Ask learners to compare savings and loan options, calculate simple and compound interest, interpret bank charges, explain the effect of inflation on value, and make justified financial decisions using realistic South African scenarios.
tasks.gr12-maps-plans-scale-t2: Grade 12 Mathematical Literacy Term 2 — Maps, Plans and Scale. Ask learners to use ratio and line scales, convert map distance to real distance and back, interpret route and layout information, choose suitable spatial representations, and solve practical questions based on maps and plans.
tasks.gr12-measurement-t2: Grade 12 Mathematical Literacy Term 2 — Measurement. Ask learners to solve applied problems involving length, mass, capacity, temperature, perimeter, area and volume; choose appropriate units and formulas; convert mixed units; and justify answers in household, workplace or civic contexts.
